title: Robustness Gym: Unifying the NLP Evaluation Landscape

bias_targets.methodology: Creating data slices and subpopulations containing specific gendered pronouns (e.g., 'she', 'her') to test for performance disparities in Natural Language Inference (NLI) models, as well as referencing datasets like Winogender and Winobias for coreference resolution.
Constructing data slices based on specific identity-sensitive words using the toolkit's SliceBuilder to evaluate potential performance degradation and bias in a commercial sentiment analysis model.
